user.title: EDF Zen Flex
user.description:
Public EDF endpoint.

Recorded history starts at installation.

tariffs.title: Contract rates and off-peak periods
tariffs.description:
Reference: EDF new subscriptions from 15 September 2026.

Check your contract before confirming.

Prices are stored locally and are not automatically updated.

Off-peak hours:

• 00:00–08:00

• 13:00–18:00

• 20:00–24:00.

All other periods are peak.

Europe/Paris time.

**If the pre-filled rates match your contract, leave “Re-import published EDF rates” unchecked, confirm the rates and submit to continue.**

To fetch the latest public grid, check “Re-import published EDF rates” and submit. You will need to submit again after reviewing the imported rates.

Imported values are shown again for review; confirmation is cleared.

history.title: Annual opening count
history.description:
Optional: enter the verified total sobriety days from January 1 through the selected date, inclusive.

Only later observations will be added.

Missing days leave the balance unknown.

A prior-year baseline is ignored in the new year.

Include the verified Bonus total, including zero if none.

For past days, see the [Hello Watt EDF Zen Flex calendar](https://www.hellowatt.fr/calendrier-zen-flex-edf/).
